frame_image_note: Video co hieu ung quet sang (light-wipe) dau tien nhung di theo huong nguoc voi cac template khac: tu nen trang (san pham chup studio sang) quet sang nen den, quet xong hoan toan khoang frame ~20/128. Khac voi smoky-pedestal/water-electric-hues, hieu ung chinh (day LED mau) KHONG bat dau ngay sau wipe ma mai den ~frame 34-36 moi xuat hien (f33 van la nen den sach hoan toan, f36 moi thay vet sang nho o duoi khung). Chon frame 30: da qua wipe tu lau, nen den sach, dien thoai chua bi anh huong boi day LED -- dung quy tac 'truoc khi hieu ung mau/thoi gian bat dau' trong note_base_frame_tim_qua_wipe.
effect_prompt: Vertical neon light strips glow softly against a plain dark background and gradually shift color over time, cycling smoothly through blue, purple, and pink/magenta hues with a soft bloom glow. The product slowly rotates in place as if resting on an invisible turntable, turning steadily to reveal it from different angles, while the camera remains completely fixed throughout. Deep black backdrop, moody colorful tech-product studio lighting.
effect_prompt_note: Quan sat cac khung 0/30/33/36/40/45/60/75/90/105/120 (128 khung/24fps). f0-f20: san pham nghieng tren nen trang sang, roi wipe quet sang nen den. f25-f33: nen den sach, chua co hieu ung gi. f36 tro di: cac vach sang doc (day LED) hien dan tu duoi khung len va lan khap nen, mau sac doi dan qua thoi gian: xanh duong/tim (f60-f90) -> hong/tia (f105-f120). San pham tu xoay tai cho kieu turntable: so sanh f0/f90/f105/f120 thay goc nhin san pham doi lien tuc (tu nghieng 3/4 sang gan nhu canh/profile) trong khi vi tri/kich thuoc khung hinh va cac vach sang nen KHONG dich chuyen -- ket luan day la san pham tu xoay, camera dung yen hoan toan (khong phai camera quay quanh san pham).
image_prompt: In image 1, the black smartphone standing upright and tilted at a slight angle in the center of the frame is completely removed, including its body, screen, camera module, buttons and edges, reflections and shadow, and nothing of its shape remains. In its place, the product from image 2 stands as the central hero product in the same spot against the plain black background, in the same position and at the same scale, standing exactly as the original product did. The product keeps its own shape and proportions from image 2 and does not take the shape of the phone. Stand the product upright and centered, matching the slightly angled, tilted presentation of the original phone. Keep the exact design of the product from image 2, including its shape, color, material, texture and every detail, with only the text and logos that are printed on it in image 2; no lettering or markings from image 1 appear on it. Keep the plain black background, the lighting and the composition exactly the same as image 1. Do not add any detail that is not in image 1 or image 2.
image_prompt_note: Phong theo cau truc smoky-pedestal/water-electric-hues. KHONG nhac den day den LED mau trong anh tinh vi base.png (frame 30) la luc nen con den trui, chua co day sang nao -- day LED doi mau la hieu ung video (time-based) chi duoc mo ta trong effect_prompt. Bo qua cau {EFFECT_CONTINUATION_DESC} cua skeleton vi khong co hieu ung nao dang hien dien trong anh goc de 'tiep tuc'.
